subject: Post-discovery: coordinate technical deep-dive and stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate technical deep-dive and stakeholder alignment

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the productive discovery yesterday. Per our notes, Nova Health is primarily focused on predictable latency for short prompt sequences, secure private deployments, and a compact KV cache strategy for sessioned workloads. The next step we talked about was a technical deep-dive with engineering and security to validate topology and provide a tentative deployment plan.

To move this forward, can you confirm who from your side will join (CTO, Security/Network, and an engineer are helpful)? We have three tentative slots next week — I included timezone conversions below: 

- Tue, Oct 20 — 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET (recommended for west-coast execs)
- Tue, Oct 20 — 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET (recommended for engineering deep-dive)
- Wed, Oct 21 — 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET (alternate morning)

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 10m — intros & goals
- 25m — architecture match: routing, KV/cache patterns, and throughput targets
- 20m — security/compliance: VPC, KMS, audit logs, and customer responsibilities
- 15m — next steps and ETA for a scoped POC

I can include Ben (network/systems) and Laura (solutions/implementation) on the deep-dive. I attached a short agenda and a network/security questionnaire so your team can signal any must-haves before the call.

If those slots don't work, propose two windows that do and we will prioritize.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF), network-security-questionnaire.xlsx (Excel)
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novahealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: coordinate technical deep-dive and stakeholder alignment

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Marcus Bloom (CTO) and I will join; I also want our lead security engineer to be present — Nora Patel (nora.patel@novahealth.ai). We prefer mornings ET — the Tue 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET slot would work best for exec alignment, but Nora asked for the engineering-heavy slot so she can hear detailed questions. Would you be able to do Tue 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET as a separate technical session that includes Ben? If it's easier, we can do a single 90-minute combined session on Wed morning ET.

Also: we have a short SSO/SAML checklist and a firewall topology doc I can share. Is it possible to add a short 10-minute run-through of OAuth/SSO options during the call?

Thanks —
Aisha
Head of Product Operations
Nova Health

External attendees: Marcus Bloom <mbloom@novahealth.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@novahealth.ai>
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: coordinate technical deep-dive and stakeholder alignment

Thanks — that makes sense. Quick proposal to cover both needs without requiring two separate meetings:

Option A (single combined session)
- Wed, Oct 21 — 08:30–10:00 PT / 11:30–13:00 ET — 90 minutes
- Agenda: quick exec alignment (15m), deep technical review (55m), SSO/network run-through and Q&A (20m)

Option B (two focused sessions)
- Tue, Oct 20 — 09:00–09:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET — exec alignment (Karthik + Marcus + Aisha)
- Tue, Oct 20 — 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET — engineering deep-dive (Ben + Laura + Nora + Marcus)

Ben can lead the network/topology discussion and Laura will cover deployment patterns and rollout/rollbacks. We'll prepare a one-page POC scope if you prefer Option B.

I've attached the agenda and the network/security questionnaire; I also added a one-page POC outline. I can create calendar invites once you confirm Option A or B and the final attendee list.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda.pdf, network-security-questionnaire.xlsx, redwood-cal-invite.ics
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novahealth.ai>, Marcus Bloom <mbloom@novahealth.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@novahealth.ai>

Date: 2026-10-16T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Oct 21 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET — Deep-dive (90m)

Hi all —

Confirming we've booked the combined 90-minute deep-dive: Wed, Oct 21 08:30–10:00 PT / 11:30–13:00 ET. Calendar invite with dial-in and a short pre-read (agenda + questionnaire) is on the way — you should see an invite from redwood-cal-invite.ics.

Quick logistics:
- I'll bring network diagrams and a short TTL-limited demo of KV cache warmup behavior.
- Laura will walk deployment topology and rollback approaches.
- Karthik will open on goals and next steps for a scoped POC.

If Nora has any firewall rules or SSO edge cases she wants us to review ahead of time, please drop them into the HubSpot record or reply-all with the doc link.

See you Wednesday —
Ben
Senior Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference
